fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-05-19, residents near Sindhu Garden Residential Colony reported repeated visits by a group of persons allegedly exchanging small packets, raising suspicion of the sale of a banned substance. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-05-19 at approximately 22:30. The complainant, Pavithra Kannan, provided the contact number 9000000453. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Balaji Karuppasamy, using the number 9000000407. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Potentially relevant material referenced includes photographs, CCTV footage and a call detail reference. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00047, as the mobile number 9000000407 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Photograph; CCTV footage; Call detail reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Repeated suspicious exchanges allegedly observed near a public place.
fields.Keywords: suspected narcotics, suspicious activity, night, mobile number, CCTV, residential colony, suspect, photograph
